field.incidentDate.meaning.value: Date on which the incident occurred.

field.incidentNotificationDate.meaning.value: Date when this claims handler was first notified of the incident by anyone, not necessarily the claimant. Not the date another insurer or organisation was notified.

field.incidentCountry.meaning.value: Country where the incident occurred; recorded as entered without inferring applicable law.

field.claimantName.meaning.value: Name of the person or company making the claim.

field.insurerName.meaning.value: Insurer recorded by the claims handler as responsible for this claim.

field.claimedCurrency.meaning.value: Currency in which the amount is claimed.

field.caseReference.meaning.value: Reference assigned by the claims handler operating this register, not an insurer reference. Unique, immutable and case-sensitive within one installation.

field.paymentDecisionDate.meaning.value: Date when this claims handler decided the amount to be paid. Not recorded until a decision is made.

field.payableAmount.meaning.value: Amount the handler decided should be paid. Not recorded until decided; may differ from the claimed amount.

field.payableCurrency.label.value: Currency of amount to be paid

field.payableCurrency.meaning.value: Currency of the amount to be paid. Not recorded until decided; may differ from the claimed currency.

field.paymentDate.meaning.value: Date when the full decided amount was paid, as recorded by the handler. Leave unrecorded if unpaid or unknown. Recording payment does not make or verify a bank transfer.

field.status.meaning.value: Whether the case is open or closed. Closing a case does not mean that payment was made.

command.OPEN.meaning.value: Register the incident, claimant, insurer and amount claimed.

command.AMEND_REGISTRATION.meaning.value: Replace the initial facts. The handler's case reference remains unchanged.

command.CORRECT_CASE.meaning.value: Correct recorded details on a case with a decision, payment or closed status. All changes are recorded together. Clearing a payment date does not refund money.

group.registration.meaning.value: Keep the current registration details or replace all seven details together.

group.decision.meaning.value: Keep the current payment decision, replace its date, amount and currency together, or clear the decision.

group.payment.meaning.value: Keep the current payment date, replace it, or clear the recorded date. Clearing the date does not refund money.

command.DECIDE.meaning.value: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.

command.WITHDRAW_DECISION.meaning.value: Clear the unpaid decision while preserving its history.

command.RECORD_PAYMENT.meaning.value: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.

command.CLEAR_PAYMENT.meaning.value: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.

command.CLOSE.meaning.value: Close the case. Closing does not mean that payment was made.

command.REOPEN.meaning.value: Reopen the case, preserving its details and history.

diagnostic.CASE_AMENDMENT_REQUIRES_UNDEC.value: “Amend registration” requires an undecided case. Use “Correct case facts” to correct recorded registration while keeping its decision.

diagnostic.CASE_CLOSED.value: This action cannot change a closed case. Use “Correct case facts” for factual corrections while keeping its status, or “Reopen the case” when you intend to resume ordinary case work.

diagnostic.CASE_DECISION_ALREADY_PAID.value: “Record payment decision” and “Withdraw payment decision” cannot change a paid decision. Use “Correct case facts” for a factual correction, with explicit payment reaffirmation or clearing when replacing a paid decision.

diagnostic.CASE_NOT_FOUND.value: The case reference was not found.
